items.text: This hardcore record runs 44 minutes and 15 seconds and was recorded at Tonteknik Studios in December 1998.
Besides Burning Heart Records, Relapse Records released the record in the USA, and Trust No One Recordings put it out on vinyl.
items.why: Lead: 'Skivan utgavs av Relapse Records i USA och på vinyl av Trust No One Recordings.' (heading 'What came after' is loose, but the sentence itself is accurate).

missed: The lead says this is Breach's third studio album ('Breachs tredje studioalbum'); the notes leave that out. The pack's track list (opening with 'Helldrivers', including a song titled 'Black Sabbath') is not used in listen_for.
